title: 刚拿到对华许可：黄仁勋却说这是错误，为何难以挽回？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The US approved selling older Nvidia chips to China, but there are companies like DeepSeek that are prioritizing building on Chinese hardware.
segments.zh: 美国批准向中国出售较旧的英伟达芯片，但像DeepSeek这样的公司正优先基于中国硬件进行构建。

segments.en: Is the promise of that market slipping away at all or shrinking at all?
segments.zh: 该市场的前景是否正在流失或萎缩？

segments.en: I did my best to inform the policymakers in the United States of the importance of engaging the Chinese market and making sure that we serve that market for as long as we can.
segments.zh: 我尽力告知美国政策制定者，与中国市场接触的重要性，并确保我们尽可能长时间地服务该市场。

segments.en: I think we made a mistake and this mistake is hard to unwind, but I did my best. That's all I could do.
segments.zh: 我认为我们犯了一个错误，这个错误难以挽回，但我已尽力。这是我所能做的。

segments.en: There are more Chinese AI researchers than any other nation in the world and many of them working at the labs.
segments.zh: 中国的人工智能研究人员数量超过世界上任何其他国家，其中许多人在实验室工作。

segments.en: I've been very clear that even though we compete against China, they're not our enemies.
segments.zh: 我一直明确表示，尽管我们与中国竞争，但他们不是我们的敌人。

segments.en: If we care deeply about the safety of the world with respect to artificial intelligence, then of course we must open dialogues, we must work with them in every possible way.
segments.zh: 如果我们深切关心人工智能领域的世界安全，那么当然必须开启对话，必须尽一切可能与他们合作。

segments.en: Is there anything that China could do or that could change in the relationship between the United States and China that would make you say maybe we shouldn't sell our chips to them?
segments.zh: 中国是否可能采取某些行动，或中美关系发生某些变化，让你觉得或许我们不应向他们出售芯片？

segments.en: Well, there are a lot of things that they can do theoretically. They're pragmatic people. They want what's in the best interest of their nation and their people.
segments.zh: 理论上他们可以做很多事情。他们是务实的人，希望符合国家和人民的最佳利益。
